_README: STAGE TWO — queries written against the frozen wants in wants.json.
Each entry is an attempt to express one want's intent. The wants were
written and frozen first; nothing here may change them. Postgres decides
whether the attempt satisfied the want, and a mismatch means THIS FILE is
wrong — not the want, and not the data.
Wants whose expectation is a `relation` have no query of their own: they
are computed from other wants' results.
Only queries that satisfy their want are eligible to move to stage three,
where the same intent is expressed in Ordo.

queries.W003: SELECT "name" FROM "people" WHERE "team" IS NOT NULL
queries.W010: SELECT "name", "salary" FROM "people" ORDER BY "salary" DESC, "id" ASC
queries.W011: SELECT "name", "salary" FROM "people" ORDER BY "salary" DESC, "id" ASC LIMIT 3
queries.W013: SELECT "org", count(*) AS n FROM "people" GROUP BY "org"
queries.W014: SELECT "org", sum("salary") AS total FROM "people" GROUP BY "org"
queries.W015: SELECT "org", count(*) AS people, count("age") AS "withAge" FROM "people" GROUP BY "org"
queries.W018: SELECT pr."name", ld."name" AS lead FROM "projects" pr JOIN "people" ld ON pr."lead" = ld."id"
queries.W019: SELECT pr."name", sp."name" AS sponsor FROM "projects" pr LEFT JOIN "people" sp ON pr."sponsor" = sp."id"
queries.W020: SELECT pr."name", ld."name" AS lead, sp."name" AS sponsor FROM "projects" pr LEFT JOIN "people" ld ON pr."lead" = ld."id" LEFT JOIN "people" sp ON pr."sponsor" = sp."id"
queries.W023: SELECT c."name", p."name" AS parent FROM "teams" c LEFT JOIN "teams" p ON c."parent" = p."id"
queries.W025: SELECT DISTINCT tk."title" FROM "tasks" tk JOIN "taskTags" tt ON tt."task" = tk."id"
queries.W026: SELECT tk."title", count(*) AS tags FROM "tasks" tk JOIN "taskTags" tt ON tt."task" = tk."id" GROUP BY tk."id", tk."title"
queries.W030: SELECT "name" FROM "people" WHERE "lastSeen" IS NOT NULL
queries.W048: SELECT "title", "priority" FROM "tasks" ORDER BY "priority" ASC, "title" ASC
queries.W049: SELECT "org", (sum("age")::bigint / count("age")) AS "avgAge" FROM "people" GROUP BY "org"
queries.W050: SELECT t."name" AS team, count(p."id") AS n FROM "teams" t LEFT JOIN "people" p ON p."team" = t."id" GROUP BY t."id", t."name"
queries.W051: SELECT tk."title", o."name" AS org FROM "tasks" tk JOIN "projects" pr ON tk."project" = pr."id" JOIN "orgs" o ON pr."org" = o."id"
queries.W052: SELECT o."name" AS org, sum(tk."points") AS points FROM "tasks" tk JOIN "projects" pr ON tk."project" = pr."id" JOIN "orgs" o ON pr."org" = o."id" GROUP BY o."id", o."name"
queries.W055: SELECT "name", ("salary" * 105 / 100) AS raise FROM "people" ORDER BY ("salary" * 105 / 100) DESC, "id" ASC
queries.W058: SELECT "name" FROM "people" WHERE "age" > 40 OR "lastSeen" IS NOT NULL
